name: Vice City
description: The Miami-inspired heart of Leonida: art deco hotels, beaches, the port and the densest streets in the state. Rockstar calls it the sun and fun capital of America.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of the Vice City sign as a plane flies over at sunset.

name: Leonida Keys
description: Tropical archipelago off the south coast. Easy-going island life next to beautiful and dangerous waters: boats, beach bars and scuba diving.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of the Leonida Keys.

name: Grassrivers
description: A primordial expanse of wetlands and mangroves. Gators, airboats, deadlier predators and weirder discoveries, according to Rockstar.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of the Grassrivers wetlands.

name: Port Gellhorn
description: A faded, once-popular vacation spot on the west coast: cheap motels, shut-down attractions and empty strip malls. Good dirt bike country.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of Port Gellhorn.

name: Ambrosia
description: Inland Leonida: industry and old-school values. Home of the Allied Crystal sugar refinery and a local biker gang.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of Ambrosia.

name: Mount Kalaga
description: Mount Kalaga National Park, a national landmark up against the northern border. Hunting, fishing and off-road trails.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of Mount Kalaga National Park.

name: Ocean Beach
description: Pastel art deco hotels and white sand on the Vice City beachfront. Named on the official site; pin position is approximate.

name: Washington Beach
description: Vice City beach with a boat dock, named in official screenshot captions. Pin position is approximate.

name: Little Cuba
description: Vice City neighbourhood known for its panaderias, named on the official site. Pin position is approximate.

name: Port Vice City
description: Port Vice City, printed on Rockstar's official Leonida Map & Cover Art Poster (Rockstar also calls it the cruise-ship capital of the world). The pin sits at the printed label.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of a Vice City marina and skyline.

name: Allied Crystal sugar refinery
description: Industrial sugar refinery in Ambrosia, named on the official site. Pin position is approximate.

name: Lake Leonida
description: Named in Ultimate Edition material (an off-road mod shop is there). Placed on the big inland lake as a guess.

name: Brian's Marina
description: Lit marina sign seen in an official Keys screenshot; fits Brian Heder's boat yard. Pin position is approximate.

name: The Rusty Anchor
description: Bar on a lit wooden pier in the Keys, reachable by boat, from an official screenshot. Pin position is approximate.

name: Tisha-Wocka Flea Market
description: Vice City flea market selling bootleg brands. Pin position is approximate. Source: rockstargames.com/VI, Vice City description.

name: One-Eyed Willie's Mod Shop
description: Mod shop in Lake Leonida specialising in off-road modifications and hand-painted automotive artistry; only open for business with the Ultimate Edition. Placed on the lake shore as a guess. Source: rockstargames.com/VI, Ultimate Edition.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of One-Eyed Willie's mod shop.

name: Shore Court Garage
description: Personal garage with a weapon locker, a stone's throw from the sands of Ocean Beach (Shore Drive). Pin position is approximate. Source: rockstargames.com/VI, Vintage Vice City Pack.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of safehouse vehicles from the Ultimate Edition.

name: Ocean View Hotel
description: Hotel seen in Rockstar's official Vintage Vice City Pack screenshots. Its exact location is not stated, so this pin is a guess near the beachfront. Source: rockstargames.com/VI, Vintage Vice City Pack gallery.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of Jason and Lucia outside the Ocean View Hotel.

name: Fishing in Gambit Bay
description: Gambit Bay is named as a spot for casting and reeling in catches; the Shitzu Squalo is shown docked at nearby Washington Beach. Pin position is approximate. Source: rockstargames.com/VI, Shitzu Squalo.

name: Scuba diving in the Leonida Keys
description: Rockstar lists scuba diving among the Keys' activities, alongside boats and beach bars. Pin position is approximate. Source: rockstargames.com/VI, Leonida Keys description.

name: Airboating the Grassrivers
description: Airboats, gators and mangroves: the Grassrivers are Rockstar's wetland playground. Pin position is approximate. Source: rockstargames.com/VI, Grassrivers description and gallery.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of the Grassrivers wetlands.

name: Hunting, fishing and off-roading
description: Mount Kalaga National Park offers prime hunting, fishing and off-road trails. Pin position is approximate. Source: rockstargames.com/VI, Mount Kalaga description.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of Mount Kalaga National Park.

name: Electric Fang Tattoo Parlor
description: Stockyard's most iconic ink bar, with over 50 signature tattoos for both Jason and Lucia, all designed by the artist collective FAILE. Only open for business with the Ultimate Edition. Pin position is approximate (placed in Stockyard; direction from GTADB record L1482, CC BY 4.0). Source: rockstargames.com/VI, Ultimate Edition.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of Electric Fang Tattoo Parlor.

name: Stock 305 Clothing Store
description: Stockyard's premier destination for elevated streetwear: unique and exclusive looks for Jason and Lucia. Only open for business with the Ultimate Edition. Pin position is approximate (placed in Stockyard; direction from GTADB record L1488, CC BY 4.0). Source: rockstargames.com/VI, Ultimate Edition.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of Stock 305.

name: PTT YOUNGIN$ Illegal Goods Store
description: The compound of one of Southside Vice City's loudest and most socially active gangs: raid it and escape safely to score special items and distinct contraband. Pin position is approximate (placed in Southside; direction from GTADB record L1491, CC BY 4.0). Source: rockstargames.com/VI, Ultimate Edition.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of the PTT YOUNGIN$ store.

name: Paradise Garage
description: Garage in Watson Bay with a weapon locker and a secure place to deposit stolen goods to be fenced; the Mud Club monster off-roader can be stored here (Ultimate Edition). Pin position is approximate (placed on the south-west coast; direction from GTADB record L1495, CC BY 4.0). Source: rockstargames.com/VI, Ultimate Edition.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of safehouse vehicles from the Ultimate Edition.

name: Delights Cabaret (strip club)
description: Strip club in Port Gellhorn. PC Gamer, GamesRadar+, Polygon, GameSpot and PowerPyx all place it in the town; GamesRadar+ says central Port Gellhorn, GameSpot the heart of the Port Gellhorn highway strip. Pin position is approximate (placed in the central town near I-404 on Rockstar's official map; exact street not confirmed). Sources: pcgamer.com, gamesradar.com, polygon.com, gamespot.com, powerpyx.com.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of a Vice City club floor as cash rains down.

name: Jack of Hearts (strip club)
description: Strip club in Crosstown, Vice City. PC Gamer places it directly north of NINE1NINE; GamesRadar+ says it is at the north end of Crosstown and opens in Chapter 3. Pin position is approximate (placed in northern Crosstown on Rockstar's official map; exact street not confirmed). Sources: pcgamer.com, gamesradar.com, powerpyx.com, gamespot.com.
imageAlt: Official GTA 6 screenshot of a Vice City club floor as cash rains down.

name: Slator Towing Inc (Chop Shop)
description: Slator Towing Inc, the illegal chop shop at the southern end of Salton, just north of the Salton Pay & Spray. It's where you search for the Schafter V12 for Raul, and it stays robbable afterwards. Player-verified by our team.

name: Fleeca – Key Lento (bank job)
description: Small bank job: loot the cash drawer and the safe. Reported take: $5,000–$20,000 in marked bills (PowerPyx, GTABase). Security: Medium (GTABase). Position from in-game coordinates (-2684, -6154), GTABase via the Open GTA 6 Map dataset, matching GTADB record L3267 (CC BY 4.0). Approximate on this map: within about a block. Full tips in our bank robbery guide.
